verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents an official MCP server (claude mcp add, https://api.cfo.ai/mcp). Through it, agents such as Claude Code or Codex can read and change the Model, including tables, formulas and Variables, and the docs give 'update this month's forecast' as an example. Every Model change is recorded in the changelog under the user's name and is undoable, and clients act as the signed-in person, so agent edits land in the same audit trail as human edits. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; explicit documentation of scenario creation through MCP tools (only implied via edit_chats driving Ari); no REST/OpenAPI interface (probe 404).
